blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-judge Robin Padilla vehemently denied on Tuesday receiving money from China after admitting involvement with the Tapang at Malasakit Foundation, which supposedly received a P150 million donation from the Chinese Embassy in the Philippines. Padilla made the denial during the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. The foundation, which lists Duterte as a member of its board of trustees, allegedly received the donation, according to former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV. “Wala po akong natanggap na pera kahit singko sa mga Intsik,” Padilla told the Senate Impeachment Court. (I haven’t received money even a centavo, from the Chinese.) […]...
